newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan tenders for 6,000 tonnes RBD plam oil.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan tenders for 6,000 tonnes RBD plam oil.

text.p: Pakistani traders said on Wednesday the state-run Trading Corporation of Pakistan (TCP) issued a tender for the supply of 6,000 tonnes of RBD palm oil for shipment up to December 31.
They said the tenders would be opened at the TCP office in Karachi at 1030 GMT.
TCP has called the tender on behalf of the state-run Ghee Corporation of Pakistan, which runs nine cooking oil mills.
Traders said prices were high in Malaysia and that the TCP would be interested only in rates quoted below $525 per tonne FOB.
